name: autoclaude
description: Runs a project's PLAN.md step by step, unattended, and verifies every step (tests, then a real headless browser) before moving on.

notify_channel.title: Notification channel
notify_channel.description: Where critical alerts go: ntfy, discord, or stdout (log only). Leave empty for auto: ntfy if ntfy_url is set, else discord if discord_webhook is set, else stdout.

ntfy_url.title: ntfy topic URL
ntfy_url.description: Full topic URL, for example https://ntfy.sh/<your-hard-to-guess-topic>. Leave empty if you use Discord.

ntfy_token.title: ntfy access token
ntfy_token.description: Only for protected topics. Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.

discord_webhook.title: Discord webhook URL
discord_webhook.description: A channel webhook URL. Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.
